4_five_slot_TX.verdict: REJECTED: not a calendar/compiler slack and not an RTL idle slot. The 1-in-5 empty beat is the hfd_ep_static gearbox: a group = 5 SerDes data beats x 510 gearbox bits = 2550 bits carrying 4 slots of S = 613 bits (512 data + metadata); a 5th slot needs 3065 bits. The 0.8 frame/beat IS the link payload rate (96% bit efficiency). Only a different link format (numerics change or wider beat) could raise it; best integer repack (9 slots / 11 beats) = +2.3% of TX serialisation (~1-2 edges/step) -> not worth an RTL change (owner 'only significant gains').
